reviews.reviewDescription: This desk lamp lights up my desk very well. The LED brightness can be easily adjusted. The USB charging port on the back of the base is usefull. The arm that holds the lighting element is a fixed height (10 inches from the base to the hinged arm). The on/off touch switch is difficult to find in the dark because it does not stick up from the surface of the base.
reviews.author: AG2MQ3OBPT5WQFFDWP5BLTBAAKWA
